purpose: Refresh primary or official sources for v468A THOS closure as scaffold readiness and v469A GMUT handoff.

source_notes.use: Frame THOS as secure-development scaffolding, not final assurance.
Keep transparency and accountability visible in blocker ledgers.
Separate governance, mapping, measurement, and management from proof claims.
Treat THOS artifacts as architecture descriptions, not the system itself.
Future digest route; not required for current closure.
Future provenance route only; no supply-chain level is claimed.
Future attestation route only; no workflow mutation.
Continue explicit push and remote equality checks.
Keep tool schema and external action boundaries explicit.

decision: Close v468A THOS only as scaffold readiness if validation passes, then hand off to v469A GMUT with all GMUT gates still open.
